question: Your hiking group is unexpectedly stranded in the mountains due to a rapidly approaching windstorm. You must immediately choose one place to shelter for the night before the storm intensifies. There are three well-known shelters within reach: Blue Lake Cabin, Red Cliff Lodge, and Green Valley Outpost. Only one option is safe and accessible—the others all hide serious dangers or are unreachable at present. Your team must coordinate and decide wisely; if you shelter in the only safe location, everyone survives. If you pick wrong, the outcome could be fatal.
